sections.title: سبق 18 — متن (178)

paras.text: Those people who, even after hearing the truth, do not take advantage of the respite for action and reform their deeds, Allah Almighty hardens their hearts, and such people are sinful. We should establish a strong connection with the Qur'an Karim and fulfil its demands.

paras.text: If a person feels that he has fallen behind in good deeds, he should not despair; he should hope that Allah Almighty, who can bring dead land to life by sending rain, can also grant the ability to do good deeds so as to irrigate the land of our hearts with the light of faith.

paras.text: Most people, at different stages of their lives, become occupied in such interests as make them heedless of fulfilling the demands of faith and religion — for example play and amusement in childhood, adornment and finery in youth, boasting of getting ahead of others in early adulthood, and in old age greed for an abundance of accumulated wealth and children. paras.text: We should not grieve too much over any loss; rather we should be patient, because the loss that was destined has happened and that loss could not have been averted; and the blessings that Allah Almighty grants us, we should not exult over them but should give thanks, because every blessing is received from the bounty of Allah Almighty and is decreed from Him.
